notes.title: 🛠️ Early Access Patch 0.9.7.3 – Gameplay Fixes & First Experimental Level
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1][p]Here comes what’s probably the fourth round of fixes since launch last week — and this one tackles a few of the more frustrating bugs you’ve reported. Let’s dive in:[/p][h2]🔧 Changelog Highlights:[/h2][list][*][p][b]Hacking Timeout UI Freeze Fixed[/b] The UI freeze after hacking timeout has been resolved. Last Saturday’s update introduced several improvements to mini-games, but I missed a bug that caused the UI and interactions to freeze when hacking timed out. That issue is now fixed. [i](I still feel like something else might have slipped through, but I haven’t found it in reports or been able to reproduce it — let me know if you notice anything.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Fix for Heavy Backpack Pickup Logic[/b] The system now correctly checks whether the player can lift an item based on their current max lift. This prevents picking up a backpack that was too heavy to carry and had just been dropped. [i]Note:[/i] Weapon and armor weight checks are coming in a separate patch soon.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Air Tank & Battery Swap Bug Fixed[/b] Swapping items like Air Tanks didn’t immediately show them as detached in the inventory, which could cause minor confusion. That’s fixed. Also improved behavior on chargers — please report if anything still seems off.[/p][/*][*][p][b]🏆 Steam Achievements Update[/b][/p][list][*][p]Achievements at the [b]Training Center[/b] are now only granted upon completing the full training sequence [i](Note: this requires confirmation of proper functionality — please report any issues)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Achievements should now be [b]disabled[/b] in the new [b]Space Test[/b] level [i](This zone is purely for testing and not part of the main progression)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]As a rule, [b]Steam achievements are intended to be available only on Tha Nesoi Island[/b], the main game area[/p][/*][*][p][i]If you unlock an achievement in Space Test... well, that’s probably a bug. Or a sign you’re too clever. Please report it.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Chargers Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where drinking while filling water could freeze the menu. You can now grab a bottle without preview or drink directly from the charger.[/p][/*][*][p]Items on chargers now support quick inventory addition. This will soon be available for all items — previews will be optional or only shown for unknown items, depending on your looter level.[/p][/*][*][p]Chargers now show [b]USE[/b] instead of [b]OPEN[/b] when accessible.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Weapons No Longer Jam When Clean & Condition > 90%[/b] Weapons should now behave more reliably. Previously, even a 100% clean weapon could jam due to frustrating randomness — calculations were correct, but the experience wasn’t. This is now toned down. [i](A bigger weapon update is coming soon.)[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Reduced Pushback Force on Player Collisions[/b] This is part of a new system still in progress, but early tweaks should feel better.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Other Small Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Materials updated for vests, plates, some bags, and backpacks[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to disable interaction immediately after waking up[/p][/*][*][p]Crafting UI: “TOOL” label changed to “PLACE AND SELECT A REQUIRED TOOL” to reduce confusion[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]🧪 New Early Access Test Level: “Space Test” (EA Only)[/h2][p]A new experimental level added just for internal testing — but since it’s already in-game, why not share it with the bravest testers?[/p][list][*][p]A small, minimalistic room packed with crates and devices for hacking, repairing, and lockpicking — all workbenches included[/p][/*][*][p]Weapons and wildlife (non-hostile) — yes, even the spiders purr sweetly if you listen closely[/p][/*][*][p]Sleeping and cooking stations available[/p][/*][*][p]Great for practicing mechanics like hacking — and once the upcoming weapon update drops, you’ll be able to test those differences too[/p][/*][*][p][i]Note:[/i] Items from this level can’t be transferred to Nesoi Island — blame the damn customs regulations[/p][/*][*][p]Achievements are disabled in this zone[/p][/*][*][p]This level was originally created for internal testing only, but if it’s well received, I’ll gladly polish it further in my spare time[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/30ff1e30aea42a988d15d9de64712d8ed5f1fec7.png"][/img][b]
Coming soon:[/b] another small test level called [b]The Impact Crater[/b]. Neither of these are part of the main game storyline... probably 😉 (After all, the game takes place on a planet — not a space station like Space Test — but hey, maybe there’s more to it.)[/p][h2]🧪 What’s Coming Soon (likely this week):[/h2][list][*][p]Performance improvements are near ready, but still untested. I didn’t want to mix them into this patch, so they’ll come separately — and we might roll back if needed[/p][/*][*][p]A dedicated fix for save/load issues: some items are appearing after load that shouldn’t. It doesn’t break the game, but it hurts immersion[/p][/*][*][p]I'm finishing work on adding save/load functionality to the Training Center[/p][/*][*][p]More bug fixes are on the way, as always[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon improvements probably won’t land this week — but I’m not ruling it out[/p][/*][*][p][b]The demo will be updated to this version soon — possibly later today or tomorrow[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]
Thanks for all your feedback and support — keep it coming![/b][/p][p]Warm regards, [b]The Developer[/b][/p]

notes.title: 🔧 EA update 0.9.7.2 — Performance Tweaks & UI Fixes (mini-games)
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1][p]Today’s update may seem small at first glance, but your feedback will directly influence how I approach future optimization.[/p][h2]✅ Fixes:[/h2][list][*][p][b]Resolved a bug that could lock the UI during mini-games:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Hacking[/p][/*][*][p]Lockpicking[/p][/*][*][p]Repairing[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h1]⚙️ Performance: Updated rendering and streaming behavior[/h1][p]This change mainly affects Nesoi Island — specifically how textures and world objects are loaded in the open environment. Recently, I noticed FPS drops at the start of the game. These weren’t caused by scene complexity, but rather by how the engine handles world loading. Earlier builds performed better, though they had other minor issues. I’d love to hear your feedback — especially on Discord — about which version runs better for you.[/p][p]⚠️ [b]Note: Textures and LOD at game start[/b] You may notice blurred textures or incorrect LODs when the game first loads. I can force high-quality loading from the start, but I’m not sure it’s necessary for all hardware setups.[/p][p]In the future, I plan to add settings that let players choose how textures are streamed and how GPU memory is managed. For now, I’m working on finding a universal default that works well across most systems.[/p][h1]🔜 What’s Next?[/h1][list][*][p]Investigating a bug causing item duplication in the world and on hangars[/p][/*][*][p]Backpack can be overloaded, and dropped items may not be picked up properly[/p][/*][*][p]Several smaller fixes and improvements are also on my list and will be addressed soon[/p][/*][/list][p]For more details, join the Discord event this Sunday — I’ll be sharing updates and answering questions live. Check the event link for your local time.
[/p][p]Thanks again for your support and feedback!

Warm regards,
[b]Paweł — creator of Hiraeth[/b][/p]

notes.title: 📢 Early Access and Demo Release Dates for ☵ HIRAETH Have Been Set!

[/b][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3803020/Hiraeth_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/h2][p]The demo launches first — on [b]August 7, 2025[/b]! While it comes with some limitations compared to the full game (and the Playtest), it offers a full taste of ☵ HIRAETH’s atmosphere and core mechanics. There are no time restrictions, and a simplified [b]save/load[/b] system will be available.[/p][p]The demo includes:[/p][list][*][p]An enhanced, refined and expanded version of what players know from the Playtest[/p][/*][*][p]Brand-new features never seen before, such as [b]lockpicking[/b], [b]hacking[/b], [b]hint system[/b], and more[/p][/*][/list][p]This is just the beginning — expect updates before the Early Access release!
[/p][h2]🚀 [b]Early Access – Coming Early September 2025

[/b][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2646160/Hiraeth/"][/dynamiclink][/h2][p]Early Access is planned for [b]early September[/b] — less than two months away! This is a developmental version of the game, crafted by a passionate indie studio.[/p][p]Your support during Early Access will help us quickly introduce major content, such as:[/p][list][*][p]Story Mode elements[/p][/*][*][p]Expansion of the Ahra Prime universe[/p][/*][*][p]New mechanics and locations[/p][/*][/list][p]If ☵ HIRAETH isn’t yet on your [b]Steam wishlist[/b], now’s the time! By doing so:[/p][list][*][p]You’ll get notified about the release[/p][/*][*][p]Enjoy an [b]exclusive launch discount[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Support a true indie project that doesn’t have a big ad budget, but is fully committed to delivering the ultimate sci-fi survival experience — for you![/p][/*][/list][p][b]The more of us there are, the greater the chance to fully realize the world of Ahra Prime — so share ☵ HIRAETH with your friends![/b][/p][h3]🛠️ [b]What’s Inside Early Access?[/b][/h3][p]Phase one focuses on [b]survival sandbox gameplay[/b], enriched with tasks and a limited story mode (in the form of logs, notes, etc.). notes.title: Big changes in ☵ HIRAETH game - Demo and Early Access coming!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Game News & Progress[/b][/h1][p]Here, on the game's website, updates and announcements are sporadic. However, playtest participants have a separate Steamcommunity where they appear with each update ☵ HIRAETH game Steam Playtest. I encourage everyone to join Playtest, these are the last days. Recently, the playtest has been completely free, it does not require my approval. As usual, I strongly encourage you and your friends to add ☵ HIRAETH to your Steam wishlist.[/p][p][b]This is of great importance for promoting the game and not wasting its potential! The game will be released in Early Access after reaching a minimum of 10,000 wishlists, which is necessary for its proper visibility at the time of premiere. Proper promotion, recognition and success will provide me with the opportunity to develop and refine it as planned.[/b] [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2646160/Hiraeth/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2][b]Some statistics[/b][/h2][p]Work on the game has been ongoing since August 2023. The project is currently in the pre-Early Access stage, which is not a bad result for a game this extensive and created by practically one person.[/p][p]A modest but playable closed playtest was launched on December 7, 2023, and since June last year it has been available to the public, after acceptance - for a few days now, as I mentioned, it has been completely free.[/p][h3][b]Playtest Participants and Wishlists[/b][/h3][p]Up until May of this year, around 1400 players participated in the playtest from the beginning and the game had around 1500 wishlists. Currently, over 3000 players participate in the playtest and the game has over 4300 wishlists.[/p][p]This is a great acceleration and motivates me to work even more![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/92197b44683e1593fbdd9d4268411e816edb8ebb.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Changes in the Playtest version only in the last half year[/b][/h3][p]Work on the game is most often visible in the playtest, although I do not include everything because not everything requires testing. Significant changes in the last half a year:[/p][list][*][p]dynamic weather system, also with an impact on gameplay;[/p][/*][*][p]mature save load system;[/p][/*][*][p]creatures - the ability to defend and hunt;[/p][/*][*][p]chargers: oxygen tanks, batteries and a water filler;[/p][/*][*][p]new weapons with degradation and repair functions;[/p][/*][*][p]complete change of inventory management, now using drag and drop;[/p][/*][*][p]player armor;[/p][/*][*][p]different types of stoves;[/p][/*][*][p]the ability to swim and dive![/p][/*][/list][p]This is only a short and incomplete list of what's new.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p][/p][/th][th][p][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/2bc009e8277f024a074669d8247e31e25b584162.png"][/img]Game UI - Operator tab[/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/5fe1d2bb7ed0b605cb1d8beef7e16fdfa3becb5b.png"][/img]The Nesoi Isand[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/c076c7c60bfecf4f783c376bef018f8f0a75a261.png"][/img]The Nesoi Isand[/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/626f4de72e2a5181deec2ef549f7fbfa278fb6af.png"][/img]Large base, social room[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/a8e425b9597a92ac084657a4d11ca864d64584c3.png"][/img]Diving view[/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/eb82e00746c7bd9d86f965e7a14d1b77154cc281.png"][/img]Investigation of the sunken transport ship[/p][/td][/tr][/table][h1][b]Playtest changes coming soon – it will end and will be replaced by beta testing[/b][/h1][p]The open Steam Playtest of the game will soon come to an end in its current form. Recently, there has been a lot of (for a single-player game) participation, which is great and very helpful for the development of the game.[/p][p][b]The Playtest will soon turn into a beta test, which will be accessible only to active and regularly reporting testers ☵ HIRAETH and supporters of the project on Patreon, Buymeacoffee and PayPal. The playtest itself in its current form will disappear when the game demo is released.
[/b]
The playtest as it stands now will likely be closed at the beginning of July, with the release of the [b]Demo[/b].[/p][h1][url="https://hiraethgame.com/#Steam"]☵ HIRAETH[/url] Game [b]Demo[/b][/h1][p]The game's Demo should appear in July. It will be a development demo, showing more or less the state of the game in the Early Access version and will be updated on an ongoing basis. A separate demo will appear for the later version of the full game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/cf8a87d324442db836c1eba6c72c04077e0a4c04.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Demo limitations and differences from the game[/b][/h2][list][*][p]language versions will appear in the demo gradually, the first version will definitely come out with an English interface, other languages ​​will be added gradually;[/p][/*][*][p]the demo should have its own key settings, and controller support next;[/p][/*][*][p]the demo will come out in a Windows version, then a Linux version, for macOS probably later, after the Early Access version is released;[/p][/*][*][p]limitations and the ability to save load is an open question, especially since in the game it will be related to the choice of the difficulty level, which will not be in the early demo;[/p][/*][*][p]one universal difficulty level, maybe others will be added later;[/p][/*][*][p]in the demo there will be only one default character to choose from, as currently in playtest;[/p][/*][/list][p][b]A separate Steam page for the demo should appear in the next few days, but it will be available for download at the end of this month or next month.[/b][/p][h1][b]Early Access[/b][/h1][h2][b]What's in the Early Access version?[/b][/h2][p]Currently, the expectations of players, Steam and popularizers have changed significantly in the last few years. A few years ago, ☵ HIRAETH could have been released at the level it was at half a year ago and no one would be surprised. I know many games that were released at such a level and are now polished and popular titles (or have faded into oblivion...). 
[/p][p][b]Today, many titles are released, also as indie games, which have little in common with indie games like ☵ HIRAETH, are polished, but on the other hand, they don't change much later. I approach Early Access as just the beginning of an adventure, and if you know the game's publishing plans - a lot will change during it![/b][/p][h3][b]Current assumptions:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]In the first version, the survival sandbox mode is similar to the one currently in playtest. Then there will be tasks, quests and a story mode will gradually appear;[/p][/*][*][p]Training Center and The Nesoi Island with a gradual expansion of the area. There will be no separate locations, simply new areas with different specifics and landscape will appear in the game. I'm already preparing other areas, but vehicles need to be added, which will happen soon;[/p][/*][*][p]There will definitely be the option to set your own keys and controller support, as well as other settings that currently only work partially in playtest;[/p][/*][*][p]The language versions listed on the game's website will appear successively, as Early Access develops;[/p][/*][*][p]In Early Access there will be a full or partial option to choose the difficulty level;[/p][/*][*][p]Full underwater exploration. In playtest this is a new option, only some underwater parts have a design as such;[/p][/*][*][p]Much more crafting, repairs and scrapping;[/p][/*][*][p]Refined weather direction;[/p][/*][*][p]Much more environmental hazards (radiation, fire, etc.), and damage will be more realistic, adjusted to the selected difficulty level;[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Achievements, which are disabled by Steam in playtest. There are currently a few test ones in playtest, not connected to your account;[/p][/*][*][p]Challenge mode. Directed challenges separate from the main gameplay;[/p][/*][*][p]Perks - connected to challenges, will make the game easier at the next start. This is just a rough but somewhat realistic plan for Early Access. [/p][/*][/list][p]The full list will be revealed at release.[/p][p][u][b]NOTE: Early Access release time is dependent on meeting the requirements to reach at least 10,000 wishlists on Steam.[/b][/u][/p][h1]Support creation now and become a legend in the ☵ Hiraeth game universe forever![/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/4c1fc62b9ddbcba1c6273ff7d82f2ba05b17e3b6.png"][/img][/p][h2]This is a real Indie game, or rather solodev[/h2][p]Although many people warned me against presenting the game as an indie game and solo dev for marketing reasons, I believe that there is no point in hiding it and that things should be presented as they are. As you can see in the playtest, there are a few people in the game's credits. At the beginning of the work on the project, they did a lot of great work, but for 2 years I have been working on the project exclusively by myself and in all aspects.[/p][h3][b]What will your support be used for?[/b][/h3][p]First of all, to continue working on the project, releasing the Early Access version. Mainly for basic needs and internet and energy bills. Working on the project takes 100% of my time, apart from the lack of private life, I also cannot take on additional paid work, which would have a disastrous effect on workflow;
If the support is greater - to join the team of other people. Many are willing, the problem is, for example, the lack of possibility to maintain the project server necessary for teamwork, which is expensive for such an extensive project.[/p][h3][b]How to support?[/b][/h3][p]The game's website lists various methods:
[url="https://www.patreon.com/c/HiraethGame" style="button"]Patreon[/url], [url="https://buymeacoffee.com/hiraethgame" style="button"]buymeacoffee[/url] and [url="https://www.paypal.com/paypalme/HiraethGame" style="button"]PayPal/HiraethGame[/url].

[b]Regardless of where you support, the rewards are equal - what counts is the amount of the payment (also cumulative), and in return you will receive different rewards. Keep your payment confirmation, it will be the basis for the reward - placing you in the game and the universe ☵ HIRAETH.[/b][/p][h3]
[b]Preferred payment methods[/b][/h3][p]It depends on your preferences, but please take into account:[/p][list][*][p]PayPal is currently the fastest and least expensive way to receive support - for you and for me;[/p][/*][*][p]When paying with Apple Pay, the smallest part of your money is allocated to the project. There is also a 70-day grace period, so your support may not arrive on time...[/p][/*][/list][p]For any questions - contact me directly, preferably on Discord or via the form at [url="https://hiraethgame.com/"]hiraethgame.com[/url]
[/p][h3][b]When will you receive the rewards for your support?[/b][/h3][p]Previous and current supporters receive rewards on an ongoing basis, with each game update. They are added to the game credits and placed in the game universe. They also appear on the game's website [url="https://hiraethgame.com/support-production-and-be-part-of-hiraeth-game-universe/"]hiraethgame.com/support-production-and-be-part-of-hiraeth-game-universe/[/url][/p][h3][b]
Example rewards for different support levels:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Placement in in-game credits[/p][/*][*][p]Placement in the colonist list in the in-game databases[/p][/*][*][p]Memory Lane Polaroid - your photo on the memory walls[/p][/*][*][p]Name of the location or shelter, region[/p][/*][*][p]Mention in notes, item names[/p][/*][*][p]Separate mini stories or mini quests with a mention[/p][/*][/list][p]And many more. I try to distinguish supporters without disturbing the immersion of the players, which is working well for now (supporters are already listed in playtest).[/p][h3][b]Until when?[/b][/h3][p]Support in this form will be possible until the release of the Early Access version. The rewards will be counted up to that point, and then the places where you can support will be closed.
Perhaps some other possibility will appear, for example the DLC Supporter Pack, but this is an unknown future for now. Such potential DLC will be completely unnecessary to play and will only contain some vanity items, with no impact on gameplay. It will also not be tied to the “become a legend in the ☵ Hiraeth game universe forever” rewards, so now is your last chance![/p][p][/p][p][i][b]Greetings to all survivors and see you in Early Access![/b][/i][/p][p]Paweł, author[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: ☵ HIRAETH game update and plans
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello players, game followers and playtest participants![/h1]
[previewyoutube=x3rlNfjYkKs;full][/previewyoutube]
I rarely post on the main game channel, but today's update is for everyone, not just our Playtest participants. Here's what we'll cover:
[b][list]
[*]     Game and Playtest Status
[*]     Release Plans, especially regarding Early Access
[*]     Details on Our New Indiegogo Campaign
[*]     Best Places to Stay Updated
[/list][/b]
Feel free to ask questions in this thread; I'm here to answer them all!
[h1]Game and playtest status[/h1]
Development on ☵ HIRAETH continues with regular Steam Playtest updates. While I'm a solo developer, the pace matches that of larger teams due to the complexity involved.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720610/a2e562b4bb058f6377991d7e37d94a26b2ca0669.png[/img]
[b]Remember, the Playtest version isn't a demo but a tool for refining the game, currently lacking full gameplay features and optimized for testing, not final user experience.[/b]
[h2]PROGRESS[/h2]
[h3]Since our Kickstarter, we've introduced:[/h3]
[list]
[*]     Save/Load System: For player and world states.
[*]     Dynamic Weather System: Including calendar-based events like sandstorms and blizzards.
[*]     New Weapon System: With various weapons and ammo types.
